questions.q: What's the most accurate way to measure flour for a cake?
o: Dip the cup into the bag
Weigh it on a digital scale
questions.why: A cup of flour can weigh 120–160 g depending on how it's filled. Grams don't lie.

questions.q: Butter is ready for creaming when…
o: Your finger leaves a dent but doesn't sink in (about 18–20°C)
questions.why: Too soft and the cake turns dense and greasy; too cold and it won't trap air.

o: Trapping loose crumbs before a chilled final coat
questions.why: A thin coat, then 20–30 minutes in the fridge, gives a clean final coat.

questions.q: What ratio of dark chocolate to cream makes a drip ganache?
questions.why: Milk chocolate needs 2:1 and white chocolate 3:1, because they're softer.

questions.q: In a two-tier cake, what carries the top tier's weight?
o: Dowels cut to the exact height of the bottom tier
questions.why: Without dowels, the top tier sinks into the bottom one.

What mainly causes 'keto flu' in the first days?
o: Low fluids and electrolytes as the body releases water and salt
questions.why: Drink more water, salt your food, and eat potassium- and magnesium-rich foods. See a doctor if symptoms are severe.

questions.q: On a Canadian Nutrition Facts table, what does the % Daily Value rule of thumb say?
o: 5% or less is a little, 15% or more is a lot
questions.why: Use it to compare products quickly: get less saturated fat, sugar and sodium, and more fibre and calcium.
Bacteria multiply fastest there. Don't leave perishable food out for more than 2 hours.

questions.q: What internal temperature should chicken pieces reach?
questions.why: Use a thermometer in the thickest part. Colour isn't a reliable test.

questions.q: What's the safe way to handle leftover cooked rice?
o: Leave it on the stove overnight
Cool it quickly, refrigerate within 1 hour and use within 1–2 days
Keep it in the fridge for a week
Freeze it while hot in a sealed pot
questions.why: Spread it on a tray to cool fast, and reheat until steaming hot.

questions.q: What does the balanced plate from Canada's Food Guide look like?
o: Half vegetables and fruits, a quarter whole grains, a quarter protein, water to drink
A third of each food group plus juice
questions.why: It works for curries, stir-fries and sandwiches too, not only plated meals.

questions.q: What's the secret to the Simple & Quick weekday plan?
o: Cooking a new dish every night
Ordering takeout three times a week
Cooking once and eating twice, with a 90-minute Sunday prep
questions.why: Prep grains, a soup, roasted vegetables and eggs on Sunday, and weeknights take minutes.
